title: selling.sellable input
description: The checks to answer, in order (a whole list in one call): each a package record and the units asked for.

record.description: The state's package record (the mirror's raw, a phone's upload or the state's live reply; only productGuid, quantity, zeroOut, locked, reasonLocked, flagged, reasonFlagged and pendingTransfer are read), or null: not in the center's inventory.

qty.description: The units asked for. Any JSON value has an answer: anything but an integer of 1 or more is refused; an integer is compared exactly, at any size.
